Bank of Communications is one of China's large state-owned commercial banks, headquartered in Shanghai, founded in 1908, with about 3,000 branches offering corporate, retail and wealth banking and credit cards. Listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong (601328, 3328). HSBC holds a notable stake. Total assets exceed 14 trillion yuan. Strong domestic brand in China, with limited consumer visibility abroad.

BNG Bank is The Hague-based Dutch public sector bank, owned by the Dutch state (50%) and municipalities and provinces, which finances Dutch local authorities, housing associations, healthcare and education institutions. It funds itself through bonds with a AAA rating and has total assets of about 150 billion euros. B2B and public sector, with no consumer brand awareness.

Charles Schwab is a Westlake, Texas-based brokerage and banking company, founded in 1971, with about $10 trillion in client assets and over 37 million active accounts across brokerage, retirement, banking and wealth advisory, after acquiring TD Ameritrade in 2020. Listed on NYSE (SCHW). Customers are retail investors, advisers and workplace plans. Strong US consumer brand, with golf and sports sponsorship including the Charles Schwab Challenge on the PGA Tour.

Citi (Citigroup) is a New York-based global bank, founded in 1812, with services in banking, markets, wealth and US consumer cards (Citi Cards, Costco and Mastercard co-brands). It operates in about 160 countries with around 230,000 employees and is listed on NYSE (C). Customers are consumers, corporations, institutions and governments. Citibank retail banking and credit cards are household names in the US, and Citi sponsors tennis and other sports and events.

Groupe BPCE is a Paris-based French cooperative banking group, formed in 2009 from Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Epargne, and also owning Natixis and Credit Foncier. It serves about 36 million customers with retail banking, insurance and investment banking in France and abroad, with total assets above 1.3 trillion euros. Owned by its cooperative members. Strong brand in France, and a long-time sponsor in sports and Olympic partnership.

HDFC Bank is a Mumbai-based Indian private bank, the largest in the country by assets and market capitalisation after merging with parent HDFC Ltd in 2023. It offers retail banking, loans, cards, payments and corporate banking to more than 100 million customers through about 9,000 branches. Listed on NSE, BSE and NYSE (HDB). Very high consumer brand awareness in India, with cricket and event sponsorships.

HSBC is a London-based global bank, founded in Hong Kong and Shanghai in 1865, serving about 40 million customers in around 60 countries with retail banking, wealth, commercial banking and global markets. Total assets are about $3 trillion. Listed in London, Hong Kong and New York (HSBA, 5, HSBC). Very high global brand awareness, and a major sponsor of sports including rugby sevens and golf.

Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) is a Beijing-based state-owned bank and the world's largest bank by assets, at over 6 trillion dollars. It offers retail, corporate and international banking through about 16,000 branches in China and more than 40 countries. Listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong (601398, 1398), majority owned by the Chinese state. Very high brand awareness in China, and a long-term Olympic and sports sponsor.

National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) is an Indian government-owned development finance institution, based in Mumbai, that refinances banks for agriculture, rural infrastructure and small enterprises and supervises cooperative and rural banks. Established in 1982. Owned by the Government of India and the Reserve Bank. B2B and policy lender, with limited consumer brand awareness, though well known in rural India.

National Debt Management Center is the Saudi Arabian government's debt office, which manages and issues government debt for the Kingdom, including sukuk and bonds, and funds the government's financing programme. Based in Riyadh, it sits under the Ministry of Finance. The reported funding of about $14 billion refers to debt issuance. Government entity, no consumer brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Postal Savings Bank of China is a Beijing-based Chinese state-owned bank, with more than 40,000 outlets, the largest retail network in the country, serving over 600 million individual customers in the mostly rural and small town market. Listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai (1658, 601658) and majority owned by China Post Group. Total assets are over 16 trillion yuan. Very high consumer awareness in China.

QNB Group is a Doha-based Qatari bank, the largest in the Middle East and Africa by assets, owned about 50 percent by the Qatar Investment Authority and listed on the Qatar Stock Exchange (QNBK). It offers retail, corporate and wealth banking in about 28 countries, including Turkey (QNB Finansbank), Egypt and Indonesia. Strong brand in Qatar, and a sponsor of football and events such as the QNB Stars League.

Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) is a Toronto-based bank, the largest in Canada by market capitalisation, offering personal and commercial banking, wealth management, insurance and capital markets in Canada, the US and 25 other countries. About 98,000 employees and assets above C$2 trillion. Listed on TSX and NYSE (RY). Very high brand awareness in Canada, a long-time sponsor of golf (RBC Canadian Open, RBC Heritage), tennis and the Olympics.

Shanghai Pudong Development Bank (SPD Bank) is a Shanghai-based Chinese joint-stock commercial bank, founded in 1992, offering corporate, retail and credit card services across China. Listed in Shanghai (600000), with China Mobile as its largest shareholder. Total assets exceed 9 trillion yuan. Strong domestic brand in China, with limited recognition outside it.

State Bank of India (SBI) is India's largest bank and a Fortune Global 500 public sector bank, based in Mumbai, with over 22,000 branches and more than 500 million customers. It offers retail, corporate, rural and international banking and owns SBI Life, SBI Cards and SBI Mutual Fund stakes. About 57 percent owned by the Government of India and listed on the NSE and BSE (SBIN). Very high brand awareness in India, and a sponsor of cricket and sports events.

Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank (ADCB) is a UAE bank based in Abu Dhabi, offering personal and business banking, cards, wealth and Islamic banking, listed on the Abu Dhabi exchange (ADCB) and partly owned by the Abu Dhabi government. It has assets above 500 billion dirhams. Customers are consumers, companies and government clients. Strong brand in the UAE, with sponsorship of sports and events.

Al Rajhi Bank is a Riyadh-based Saudi Arabian bank, the world's largest Islamic bank, offering Sharia-compliant retail, SME and corporate banking, auto and home finance, with over 500 branches and millions of customers. Listed on the Saudi exchange (1120) and founded by the Al Rajhi family. Strong consumer brand awareness in Saudi Arabia, and a sponsor of sports and events in the Kingdom.

Allied Irish Banks (AIB) is a Dublin-based Irish bank, rescued by the state in 2009 and now about 7 percent held by the Irish government after returning to the market, with retail, SME and corporate banking in Ireland and the UK (First Trust in Northern Ireland). Listed on Euronext Dublin and London (A5G). Customers are millions of households and businesses. Very high brand awareness in Ireland, a sponsor of GAA and other sports.

AXA Group is a Paris-based global insurer, founded in 1985, offering property-casualty, health, life and asset management to about 93 million customers in 50 countries, with revenue of around 100 billion euros. Listed on Euronext Paris (CS). Very high consumer brand awareness in Europe, with long-standing sports sponsorship, including rugby and golf and, in the past, football.

Axis Bank is a Mumbai-based Indian private bank, the third-largest in the country, offering retail, corporate, and wealth banking, cards and Citi India's consumer business (acquired in 2023). It has over 5,000 branches and listed on NSE and BSE (AXISBANK). Customers are tens of millions of Indians. High consumer brand awareness in India, and a sponsor of cricket and sports.

about: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) is a Siena, Italy-based bank founded in 1472, the world's oldest surviving bank, offering retail, SME and corporate banking, wealth and insurance. The Italian state rescued it in 2017 and holds a stake; it took over Mediobanca in 2025. Listed on Borsa Italiana (BMPS). Customers are Italian households and firms. Strong brand in Italy, a sponsor of the Palio di Siena and basketball.

Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA) is a Bilbao and Madrid-based Spanish bank with large operations in Mexico (BBVA Mexico), Turkey (Garanti BBVA), Spain and South America, serving about 80 million customers. Listed on the Madrid exchange and NYSE (BBVA). It owns the digital bank brand and has total assets above 800 billion euros. Very high consumer brand awareness in Spain and Mexico, with sports sponsorship including LaLiga and Liga MX.

Bank of Baroda is a Vadodara-based Indian public sector bank, the second-largest by assets after SBI among public lenders, founded in 1908, with about 8,000 branches in India and operations in 17 countries. About 64 percent owned by the Government of India and listed on NSE and BSE (BANKBARODA). Customers are retail and corporate. Strong brand in India, and a sponsor of cricket and sports.

Bank of India is a state-owned commercial bank headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 1906 and nationalised in 1969. It offers retail, corporate, SME, agricultural and international banking through thousands of domestic branches plus overseas branches in major financial centres including London, Singapore and Hong Kong. Customers range from individuals to large corporates and government bodies; revenue comes from lending margins and fees. The Government of India is the majority shareholder and the shares are listed on the NSE and BSE. Well known in India, little visibility elsewhere.

Bank of Jiangsu is a Chinese joint-stock commercial bank headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu province, listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. It provides corporate lending, retail banking, wealth management, treasury and financial markets services, mainly across Jiangsu and the Yangtze River Delta, with branches in other major Chinese cities. Customers are local enterprises, SMEs and individuals, and income comes from loan interest and fees. It is a large regional lender by Chinese standards. Regional brand with low international consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Bank Of Jiangsu is a modern joint-stock commercial bank...

about: Bank of Montreal (BMO Financial Group) is one of Canada's five largest banks, founded in 1817 and headquartered in Toronto, with a registered office in Montreal. It offers personal and commercial banking, wealth management and capital markets, with a large US presence after acquiring Bank of the West in 2023 and BMO Harris Bank. It serves millions of retail and corporate clients and earns money from lending spreads, fees and investment services. Listed on the TSX and NYSE as BMO. Strong consumer brand in Canada and the US Midwest, and an existing sports sponsor (BMO Field, golf).

Blue Owl Capital is a New York-based alternative asset manager listed on the NYSE (OWL), formed in 2021 through a SPAC merger of Owl Rock and Dyal Capital. It manages well over 200 billion dollars across direct lending, GP strategic capital, and real assets such as net lease and digital infrastructure including data centres. Clients are institutions, insurers and wealthy individuals, and it earns management and performance fees. Blue Owl has taken sports-related stakes in minority team-ownership funds. B2B financial brand with low consumer awareness.

Broadridge Financial Solutions is a fintech provider of investor communications, proxy voting, securities processing and wealth technology, spun off from ADP in 2007. Its platforms process trillions of dollars in daily trading volume for banks, broker-dealers, asset managers and public companies, with about 14,000 employees and revenue near 6.5 billion dollars. It is headquartered in Lake Success, New York, with offices worldwide, and is listed on the NYSE (BR). B2B infrastructure, little consumer brand awareness.

Canara Bank is a large Indian public sector bank headquartered in Bengaluru, founded in 1906 and nationalised in 1969. It provides retail, corporate, agriculture and MSME banking across thousands of branches and ATMs in India, with branches abroad, and owns stakes in asset management and insurance joint ventures. Customers are individuals, farmers, SMEs and corporates; revenue comes from lending and fees. Government of India holds the majority and shares trade on NSE and BSE. Recognisable consumer brand in India, mainly southern regions.

China CITIC Bank is a major Chinese joint-stock commercial bank headquartered in Beijing, majority-owned by CITIC Group. It provides corporate and retail banking, credit cards, wealth management and cross-border finance through over 1,400 branches nationwide, and is dual-listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong. Customers are Chinese enterprises, state-linked firms and individuals; revenue comes from loan interest, card fees and treasury. Well known in China, with limited consumer awareness elsewhere.

China Construction Bank is one of China's Big Four state-owned banks and among the world's largest by assets, headquartered in Beijing and listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai. It provides corporate, retail, infrastructure and property finance, wealth management and international banking through around 14,000 domestic outlets and branches in major world cities. Customers include state enterprises, SMEs and hundreds of millions of individuals; the state fund Central Huijin is the leading shareholder. Strong brand in China and a presence in global financial rankings.

CIBC (Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce) is one of Canada's Big Five banks, headquartered in Toronto, tracing its roots to 1867. It provides personal and business banking, credit cards, wealth management, capital markets and US commercial banking through CIBC Bank USA, serving over 10 million clients. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (CM), with revenue around 20 billion Canadian dollars. Revenue comes from lending spreads, fees and advisory work. Strong Canadian consumer brand with local sports and community sponsorships.

Citibanamex (Banco Nacional de Mexico, Banamex) is one of Mexico's largest banks, founded in 1884 and headquartered in Mexico City. It offers retail banking, credit cards, SME and corporate banking, and wealth management through hundreds of branches. It was owned by Citigroup from 2001, which announced a split in 2022 and sold a 25 percent stake to Fernando Chico Pardo in 2025 as it prepared an IPO; Banamex operates as a separate entity. Customers are Mexican individuals and businesses. Very well-known consumer brand in Mexico and historic sports sponsor.

Clifford Capital is a Singapore-based specialist finance company providing export credit, project finance and infrastructure and marine lending to companies, especially in Asia. Founded in 2012 with Temasek among its backers, it works with insurers and banks. Customers are corporates, shipping and infrastructure firms. The listed funding amount appears to be debt raised. B2B financial institution with low public brand awareness.

about: CloudWalk is a Brazilian fintech headquartered in Sao Paulo that operates the InfinitePay payments business and the JIM.com platform, offering card machines, digital accounts, credit and merchant services to small and medium businesses. Founded in 2013, it has raised well over 300 million dollars from investors including Valor Capital and Redpoint, with a valuation above 2 billion dollars. Revenue comes from transaction fees, credit and account services. Strong brand among Brazilian small merchants, expanding in Latin America and the US.

CreditAccess Grameen is an Indian microfinance company headquartered in Bengaluru, a leading non-banking financial company providing small joint-liability loans to women in rural and semi-urban areas through branches across more than a dozen states. It serves millions of borrowers with a loan portfolio above 25,000 crore rupees, and is majority owned by CreditAccess Asia, backed by Creation Investments. Listed on NSE and BSE as CREDITACC. Revenue is interest and fees. Regional lender with low urban consumer brand awareness.

Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest bank, headquartered in Frankfurt, founded in 1870 and listed on the NYSE and Frankfurt exchange (DB). It operates Corporate Bank, Investment Bank, Private Bank and DWS asset management, serving retail, corporate and institutional clients in about 60 countries with roughly 90,000 employees. Revenue comes from lending, trading, advisory and fees. Major global financial brand with a history of sports and cultural sponsorship, including partnerships in golf and football.

Doha Bank is a commercial bank headquartered in Doha, Qatar, founded in 1979 and listed on the Qatar Stock Exchange. It offers retail, corporate, private and Islamic-style banking, plus trade finance, in Qatar and through branches and representative offices in India, Kuwait, UAE, Turkey and other markets. Revenue comes from lending spreads and fees. Among Qatar's larger private banks. Established local brand with limited global recognition.

about: Dubai Islamic Bank is the world's first full-service Islamic bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Dubai, and the largest Islamic bank in the UAE by assets. It offers Sharia-compliant retail, corporate, wealth and treasury services, with branches across the UAE and operations in Pakistan, Kenya and elsewhere. Customers include individuals, SMEs and corporates; the Investment Corporation of Dubai is a major shareholder. Listed on the Dubai Financial Market. Strong regional consumer brand and an active sponsor in the Gulf.

Emirates NBD is a leading banking group in the Middle East headquartered in Dubai, formed in 2007 from the merger of Emirates Bank and National Bank of Dubai, majority owned by Investment Corporation of Dubai. It provides retail, corporate, Islamic and private banking, including Liv digital bank and Network International-linked payments, with operations in UAE, Egypt, Turkey (DenizBank), India and Saudi Arabia. Listed on Dubai Financial Market. Strong regional consumer brand and prominent sponsor of sport and events in Dubai.

Erste Group is a leading Austrian banking group headquartered in Vienna, with about 16 million customers in Austria, Czechia, Slovakia, Romania, Hungary, Croatia and Serbia through brands like Erste Bank, Ceska sporitelna and Slovenska sporitelna. It provides retail, corporate and capital markets banking, with about 45,000 employees and listing on Vienna Stock Exchange (EBS). Founded 1819. Strong consumer brand in Central and Eastern Europe, involved in sports and arts sponsorship.

First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the UAE's largest bank, formed in 2017 by the merger of National Bank of Abu Dhabi and First Gulf Bank, and headquartered in Abu Dhabi. It provides corporate and investment, retail, private banking and global markets services across the UAE and international offices in over 20 markets, with assets above 1 trillion dirhams. Partially owned by the Abu Dhabi sovereign Mubadala and ruling family entities; listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. Strong Gulf brand and a major sports sponsor.
